### A Prayer About Loving to be First
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/a-prayer-about-loving-to-be-first/
Passage: 3 John 1:9-10
Points:
- Diotrephes's cautionary legacy warns against the destructive desire to put oneself first.
- Selfish ambition subtly poisons marriage, friendship, and professional work through self-promotion and pride.
- Believers regularly battle self-absorbed habits in the mundane moments of daily life.
- Jesus exemplified true greatness by refusing to grasp power and instead giving His life as a servant.
- Deepening our love for Christ alone breaks the persistent drive to demand priority over others.

### Imitate Good
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/imitate-good
Passage: 3 John 1:11
Points:
- Diotrephes rejected apostolic authority and withheld hospitality out of a selfish desire to protect his status.
- True Christian faith cannot be separated from moral fruit and loving service toward fellow believers.
- Demetrius stands in contrast as a faithful servant whose life and reputation reflected the truth.
- Critical attitudes toward church leaders frequently stem from personal jealousy rather than genuine conviction.
- Christians are called to follow godly examples of humility rather than adopting self-serving behavior.
